name: Fermi Inc. Common Stock
summary: Fermi Inc. is dedicated to establishing essential energy infrastructure. The company plans to build an integrated campus that combines energy production with data center facilities, designed to meet the significant requirements of forthcoming artificial intelligence infrastructure. Co-founded by Rick Perry, Toby Neugebauer, and Griffin Perry, the firm was established on January 10, 2025, and operates from its headquarters in Amarillo, Texas.
